purpose: The Stage-4 final closure manifest: every authoritative artifact path/hash, the final architecture decision, formal Pareto status, acceptance gates A-H closure record, pending science, and Coordinator decisions, for independent audit.

authoritative_artifacts.description: Acceptance gates A-H (Science Owner authored, severity/evidence/owner)
Gate D burden-completeness assessment, v3.0.0, CONDITIONALLY_READY + coordinator_acceptance
Gate E options prepared (historical, no_option_selected=true - superseded by decisions below)
Gate E Coordinator decisions - FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY x2, with revision triggers
Configuration-level burden matrix, 4 classes, computed robustness
Formal multi-objective Pareto dominance analysis - COMPLETE
THE canonical final architecture decision - CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT
Pre-closure decision packet (historical aggregation input, superseded by final_wearable_architecture.json as the decision-of-record)
Science Owner claim ledger - exact safe wording per claim area
Integration Owner claim-update - supersedes final_architecture/pareto claim wording only

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: Every sensor included in the frozen architecture has a documented scientific rationale traceable to a specific governing Stage-3 family.
acceptance_gates.evidence: A citation from results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json or results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json for every included sensor.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Coordinator's final architecture document cites this manifest/ledger per sensor.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - every included sensor traces to results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json / results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json (cited in final_wearable_architecture.json science_rationale).

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: Every serious candidate sensor that is excluded has a documented reason (not silence).
acceptance_gates.evidence: A citation from results/stage4_scientific_sensor_value_matrix.json or results/stage4_architecture_decision_inputs_science.json explaining the exclusion.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Coordinator's final architecture document cites the specific exclusion rationale per excluded sensor.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - every excluded sensor (thoracic BioZ, leg BioZ, second-site PPG, wrist temp/light) has documented evidence-based rationale in final_wearable_architecture.json exclusion_rationale.

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: No bounded or pending result is represented as a verified external replication in the final architecture document.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Cross-check final architecture wording against results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json's prohibited_stronger_wording fields.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Running the claim-consistency validator against the final architecture document text before freeze.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - EOG/sparse-EEG wording remains bounded/conditional per results/stage4_gate_e_coordinator_decisions.json claim_limitations; validated by ml/validate_stage4_final_architecture_closure.py.

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: Engineering burden accounting includes body region, contact/electrode count, module count, and attachment/strap burden - not chip/component count alone.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Integration Owner's burden analysis explicitly covering all four dimensions per candidate sensor.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Integration Owner publishes a burden analysis artifact covering all four dimensions; Science Owner's role is limited to flagging which dimensions matter scientifically (done in results/stage4_scientific_pareto_inputs.json's uniqueness/dependency fields).
acceptance_gates.final_state: CONDITIONALLY_READY, CLOSED_FOR_STAGE4_BY_COORDINATOR_ACCEPTANCE_OF_BOUNDED_ENGINEERING_UNCERTAINTY (results/stage4_gate_d_burden_completeness.json coordinator_acceptance) - NOT silently relabeled READY.

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: For every modality with decision_sensitivity=HIGH in results/stage4_sensor_decision_sensitivity.json, the Coordinator has explicitly chosen one of: WAIT, FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY, or FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSURE.
acceptance_gates.evidence: An explicit Coordinator statement for EOG (HMC-dependent) and sparse/full EEG (ds003838-dependent), the two current HIGH-sensitivity items.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: A recorded Coordinator decision (WAIT / FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY / FREEZE_DESPITE_UNCERTAINTY_WITH_DISCLOSURE) for each current HIGH-sensitivity item.
acceptance_gates.final_state: CLOSED_BY_COORDINATOR_DECISION - both HIGH-sensitivity items (EOG/HMC, sparse-vs-full EEG/ds003838) FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY with explicit revision triggers (results/stage4_gate_e_coordinator_decisions.json).

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: The final architecture rationale must not omit or contradict adverse evidence (thoracic EIS mixed/negative-leaning, second-site PPG negative, leg BioZ heterogeneous).
acceptance_gates.evidence: Final architecture document explicitly references and does not contradict results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json's negative/mixed families.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Final architecture document is checked against the manifest for consistency before freeze.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - thoracic BioZ COMPLETE_MIXED, leg BioZ aggregate-negative, second-site PPG negative all preserved verbatim in final_wearable_architecture.json exclusion_rationale, never rewritten as clean negatives or erased.

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: The final architecture's public/jury-facing claims match the scientific evidence exactly - no stronger wording than the claim ledger permits.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Final claims cross-checked against results/stage4_science_claim_ledger.json's exact_safe_wording and prohibited_stronger_wording fields.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Running the claim-consistency validator against all final public-facing claim text.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - validated by ml/validate_stage4_science_claim_consistency.py (18 pre-closure artifacts remain UNRESOLVED/NOT_READY) and ml/validate_stage4_final_architecture_closure.py (4 new closure artifacts internally consistent, no false dominance, no premature HMC/ds003838 completion).

acceptance_gates.original_requirement: The final wearable architecture decision does not imply, state, or suggest that the Digital Twin has been validated as a trained, longitudinal, personalized model.
acceptance_gates.evidence: Final architecture document explicitly states the Digital Twin's conceptual/synthetic/unvalidated status wherever it is mentioned.
acceptance_gates.closure_mechanism: Final architecture document is checked for Digital Twin mentions and verified against the ledger's required disclaimer.
acceptance_gates.final_state: PASS - Digital Twin not mentioned in any new closure artifact; results/digital_twin_architecture_footprint.json's ARCHITECTURE_ONLY_UNTRAINED_UNVALIDATED status is untouched and unreferenced by the wearable architecture decision.

pending_science.hmc_full_cohort: LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING - not run, not marked complete, not required for Stage-4 closure under FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.
pending_science.ds003838_full_cohort: LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING - not run, not marked complete, not required for Stage-4 closure under FREEZE_CONDITIONALLY.
pending_science.digital_twin: ARCHITECTURE_ONLY_UNTRAINED_UNVALIDATED (results/digital_twin_architecture_footprint.json) - unaffected by, and not implied by, this architecture closure.

gate_e_decisions.item: Sparse-vs-full EEG electrode-count minimization (ds003838 full cohort)

coordinator_decisions.coordinator_selection_rationale: Coordinator selected CORE_PLUS_CONTEXT from the Pareto-relevant set because the EOG increment adds controlled sleep-staging evidence at low incremental physical burden without adding a new body region or full module, while accepting conditional external-validation uncertainty.

repository_sha_note: This is the repository HEAD SHA at manifest-generation time (the parent of this sprint's closure commit(s) - a file cannot embed its own resulting commit hash without amending, which this project's git discipline avoids). The actual final closure commit SHA is reported in the branch push report/PR, not embedded here.
